Cc: Tom Bowers <tom.bowers@gridlockenergy.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: customer reference for late-stage procurement (utility use case)

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at GridLock liked the model fallbacks and the per-route latency dashboards. Procurement asked for two short reference calls with existing utility customers that have deployed Redwood in a similar grid-edge optimization workload.

Scope we care about:
- Energy/utility operator (distribution-level)
- Real-time inference for outage prediction / crew dispatch
- Running in a VPC/private deployment with encryption at rest + SOC2 evidence

Can you connect us with 1) a US-based utility customer who can speak to private deployment and 2) a production user who can comment on latency & cost tradeoffs over a 6–12 month horizon? We prefer calls next week (July 5–8) or the week after.

I attached the RFP excerpt and the MAP for context — apologies if some asks overlap with what you already have.

Thanks,
Elena

Head of Procurement, GridLock Energy

+1 (415) 555-0143

Subject: Re: Request: customer reference for late-stage procurement (utility use case)

Elena —

Really appreciate the specificity, that's helpful. We have two customers that map well:
1) NorthStar Utilities (US-Midwest) — private deployment, VPC-only, did a phased rollout and can speak to SOC2 evidence collection and onboarding time.
2) VoltaGrid (pilot in CA) — running hosted + dedicated hybrid for latency-sensitive inference; they can talk cost modeling and kernel-level perf tuning we suggested.

Vanessa — can you coordinate short 30-minute calls with the two advocates? Ideally keep them separate (one on private deployment/security, one on latency/cost). Rishi / Aditya, please be ready to surface the short technical playbook (1 pager) during the call.

Proposed slots: July 6 (AM PT) for NorthStar, July 7 (PM PT) for VoltaGrid. Elena — if those work, we'll send calendar invites and ask advocates for 10–12 minute front-of-call intros + 15 minutes for Q&A.

Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
